mapper.select: SELECT ci.BEAD_CODE as steelRingCode, IFNULL(SUM(ms.PLAN_SURPLUS_QTY * 2), 0) as monthRemainQty FROM t_mdm_month_surplus ms LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT MATERIAL_CODE, BEAD_CODE FROM T_MDM_CONSTRUCTION_INFO WHERE IS_DELETE = 0 ) ci ON ms.MATERIAL_CODE = ci.MATERIAL_CODE WHERE ms.IS_DELETE = 0 AND ms.YEAR = #{year} AND ms.MONTH = #{month} GROUP BY ci.BEAD_CODE HAVING ci.BEAD_CODE IS NOT NULL
